thread:
joel: GreenBridge flagged a customs stop on 10x H100 inbound CDG. Broker says shipment marked as RMA but paperwork shows 'replacement' on vendor invoice. They're holding until proper RMA docs or corrected commercial invoice.
maria: We planned to allocate 6 to Dedicated EU pool tomorrow. If this is RMA, customs needs return authorization docs, could be >72h.
derek: Forwarder options: 1) Correct invoice with HS 847330 & remark "commercial replacement" and broker clears (~24-36h); 2) Reclassify as RMA with vendor-provided RMA cert and expedite broker (~36-48h + $2.2k). AWB: `GBR-CDG-7788`. Tracking: https://carrier.example/GBR-CDG-7788
joel: vendor-bot, confirm if Arclight (vendor) sent RMA docs or if this is a mislabel. Any serials marked as DOA?
vendor-bot: Arclight note: vendor shipped as replacement units due to previous DOA claim. Vendor provided an internal RMA ref but did not attach the customs RMA certificate. No DOA units expected in this shipment.
lina: Firmware parity check: some EU infra racks require v1.3 fw. We need 6 fw-matched H100s. Temp pool: EU spares H100 x2, H100 loaners x1 in FRA, H200 x5. So only 3 immediate H100s.
maria: Can we borrow 3 from APAC spare pool? Cross-region transfer adds lead time. Not ideal.
derek: Short term plan: ask Arclight to resend corrected commercial invoice marking "commercial replacement" with HS=847330 and include vendor RMA ref on invoice line. That should resolve broker hold in ~24-36h. Vendor offered to cover broker handling fee $600 if we sign off corrected invoice by EOD.
joel: Procurement, can you confirm vendor will send corrected invoice now? proc-fin?
procure-fin: Arclight emailed a corrected invoice draft and agrees to cover $600 handling. Need GL for chargeback (use GL-INF-OPS). We'll need signed acknowledgment.
lina: If corrected invoice clears in 36h, we lose 12h on rollout window. Can infra accept 4 H100s + 2 H200 for rollout? We'll degrade non-critical services to H200.
maria: Product willing to delay 12h if cleared. Alternative is air-divert to CDG expedited lane (~18h) but +$12k. Not worth it if vendor covers $600.
derek: Draft instruction to forwarder to accept corrected invoice and release on clearance. Code snippet we sent to Arclight:
```
INVOICE_FIX: COMM_REPL
HS_CODE: 847330
RMA_REF: ARCL-2026-889
ACK_SIGNER: joel@redwood.example
```
joel: Signed and returned. Created ticket INF-2520 to track. Arclight confirmed they sent corrected invoice to broker.
vendor-bot: Broker acknowledged receipt of corrected invoice and queued clearance. Expected broker action 24-36h. Will update tracking when released.
procure-fin: GL INF-OPS noted. Vendor reimbursement confirmed $600. Attach invoice to INF-2520.
maria: I'll tentatively hold the Dedicated rollout by 12h and update stakeholders.
lina: Good coordination. If this slips we fallback to the contingency AWS burst for 24h.
jeol: typo fixed: joel: :smiley: Thanks team.
